creatures.name: Xardorok Sunblight
creatures.flav: The self-styled Iron Tyrant of the duergar, a Sunblight fanatic who dreams of dragging Ten-Towns into the dark beneath a chardalyn wing.

acts.name: Enlarge
acts.text: For the duration, Xardorok is Large, his Spiked Gauntlet dice explode, and he has Favor on Might Checks and Saves.

acts.name: Vanish
acts.text: Xardorok is Invisible until he Attacks, Casts, uses Enlarge, or his Focus breaks.

acts.name: Spiteful Flame
acts.text: Reaction. When damaged by a Being it senses, that Being takes 8 (3d4) Fire damage and is Burning (Cd4).

creatures.name: Chardalyn Dragon
creatures.flav: A dragon-shaped engine of black chardalyn crystal, built by duergar hands and given a stolen dragon's fury. It has no mind of its own to reason with.

acts.name: Tail
acts.text: Target is shoved 15' and Prone.

acts.name: Malevolent Presence
acts.text: Targets are Charmed and fixate on a target of the dragon's choice, moving toward it and Attacking it on their Turn.

acts.name: Chardalyn Breath
acts.text: Bonus burst, not counted in steady DPR.

creatures.name: Arveiaturace
creatures.flav: An ancient white wyrm who has ruled the Reghed Glacier since before Ten-Towns had a name. Duergar sky-priests court her with tribute; everyone else simply prays she stays asleep.

acts.name: Tail
acts.text: Target is shoved 30' and Prone.

acts.name: Glacial Breath
acts.text: Cold damage. Targets are Dazed (Cd6, Speed reduced by 20') if failed. Bonus burst, not counted in steady DPR.

acts.name: Immutable
acts.text: It can't be transformed.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

acts.name: Terror of the Glacier
acts.text: Enemies that see it for the first time, and at the start of their Turns thereafter, must pass [Will] or be Frightened (Cd6).

creatures.name: Chardalyn Berserker
creatures.flav: A duergar or human warrior whose mind was hollowed out and refilled with something else the moment they picked up chardalyn weapons in Xardorok's forges.

acts.name: Chardalyn Flail
acts.text: Target is Sickened until the end of its next Turn if it fails.

acts.name: Chardalyn Madness
acts.text: At the start of its Turn, roll a d6. On a 1, it does nothing but rave to a master that isn't there.

acts.name: Reckless
acts.text: At the start of its Turn, it can gain Favor on its melee Attacks this Turn, but Attacks against it have Favor until its next Turn.

creatures.name: Ice Troll
creatures.flav: A troll that has made its peace with the Everlasting Rime, growing a hide of rime-frost and a hatred of warmth to match its hatred of everything else.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: Target has Hinder on Attacks until the end of its next Turn if it takes this damage.

acts.name: Cold Aura
acts.text: Any Being that starts its Turn within Close takes this damage.

acts.name: Lesser Regenerate II
acts.text: Regains 10 HP on each of its Turns unless it took damage it was Weak to in the last Round. It can't be reduced below 1 HP except by damage it is Weak to.

creatures.name: Goliath Werebear (Toji)
creatures.flav: A goliath cursed - or blessed - with the spirit of the great bear. Fiercely protective of Icewind Dale's few remaining innocents.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: A Humanlike hit by this must pass [Endure] or be cursed with werebear lycanthropy.

acts.name: Stone's Endurance
acts.text: Reaction. When damaged, reduce the damage taken by 8 (d12+2).

creatures.name: Grandolpha Muzgardt
creatures.flav: A duergar witch of dubious loyalty who trades secrets, poisons, and polymorphs for coin - or for a favor she'll collect on later.

acts.name: Vanish
acts.text: Grandolpha is Invisible until she Attacks or Casts a Spell that deals damage.

acts.name: Hidebound
acts.text: Grandolpha gains 3 Armor for the duration.

acts.name: Sculpt Flesh
acts.text: As the Polymorph Spell, Targeting only herself.

creatures.name: Auril, the Frostmaiden (First Form)
creatures.flav: The goddess of winter's cruelty, wearing a shape of frost-feathers and talons. She cannot truly die here - only be driven from one mask into the next.

acts.name: Talons
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Touch of Frost
acts.text: Target can't take Reactions until the start of its next Turn.

acts.name: Divine Rejuvenation
acts.text: When reduced to 0 HP, Auril's body melts away and she reappears at full HP in her Second Form within Near.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Auril, the Frostmaiden (Second Form)
creatures.flav: Stripped of her first mask, Auril rises as a knight carved from glacier ice, morningstar in hand and murder in her unreadable face.

acts.name: Ice Morningstar
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Frost Nova
acts.text: Any Being within Close takes this Cold damage when Auril is struck in melee (no Action).

acts.name: Cone of Cold
acts.text: Bonus burst, not counted in steady DPR.

acts.name: Ice Stasis
acts.text: Target must pass [Will] or become Restrained and Vulnerable in an ice crystal, taking 21 (6d6) Cold damage at the start of each of its Turns until it breaks free or the crystal (0 Armor, 9 HP, Immune except Fire) is destroyed.

acts.name: Divine Rejuvenation
acts.text: When reduced to 0 HP, Auril's body shatters and she reappears at full HP in her Third Form within Near.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Auril, the Frostmaiden (Third Form)
creatures.flav: A shard of pure winter, all that's left when the masks come off - and the most dangerous thing Auril has ever been.

acts.name: Frigid Aura
acts.text: Any Being that Ends its Turn within Close takes this Cold damage.

acts.name: Blizzard Veil
acts.text: A 30' radius sphere centered on Auril is heavily obscured for the duration.

acts.name: Divine Resurrection
acts.text: When reduced to 0 HP, Auril's crystalline form shatters and she is gone - until the next winter solstice, when she reappears at full HP somewhere cold and remote.

acts.name: Magic Ward IV
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 4 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Frost Giant
creatures.flav: A hulking raider of the Reghed Glacier, patchwork-armored and greataxe-armed, who measures worth in plunder and the size of what it can throw.

creatures.name: Abominable Yeti
creatures.flav: The largest and cruelest of its kind, driven from even the yeti packs of the high Spine for what it did to them.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Chilling Gaze
acts.text: Target within Near that can see it must pass [Endure] or take 21 (6d6) Cold damage and be Paralyzed for 1 Minute, repeating the Save at the end of each of its Turns. On a pass (or the Paralysis ending), it is immune to this Gaze for 1 Hour.

acts.name: Cold Breath
acts.text: Cold damage.

creatures.name: Yeti
creatures.flav: A shaggy, ape-like predator of the high passes above Icewind Dale, more territorial than truly evil.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: plus 9 (2d8) if failed by 5 or more

acts.name: Terror Glare
acts.text: Frightened (Cd4, Paralyzed).

creatures.name: Winter Wolf
creatures.flav: Xardorok's hunting packs range the tundra on four frost-white legs, breath steaming with more than cold.

acts.name: Frost Breath
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Pack Hunter
acts.text: Targets within 5' of one of this Being's Allies are Vulnerable to its attacks.

acts.name: Pounce
acts.text: If it moves at least 20' before an attack on the same Turn, the Target is also knocked Prone if it is Large or smaller.

creatures.name: Vellynne Harpell
creatures.flav: A pragmatic Arcane Brotherhood wizard chasing rumors of Netheril, more interested in what Icewind Dale can teach her than what it can give her.

acts.name: Chill Touch
acts.text: Target can't regain HP until the start of Vellynne's next Turn.

acts.name: Vampiric Touch
acts.text: Vellynne regains HP equal to half the damage dealt.

acts.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
acts.text: Always hits.

creatures.name: Duergar Hammerer
creatures.flav: A duergar strapped into a hulking iron frame of pistons and grinding gears, more machine than dwarf until the frame breaks open.

acts.name: Engine of Pain
acts.text: Once per Turn, an Attacker can target the duergar trapped inside instead, at Hinder. On a hit, the hammerer takes an extra 5 (d10) damage and can Attack immediately as a Reaction.

creatures.name: Gunvald Halraggson
creatures.flav: King of the Tribe of the Bear, a mountain of a man who has never lost a duel and doesn't plan to start.

acts.name: Menacing Blows
acts.text: Deals an extra 6 (d12) damage with a weapon Attack. Target must pass [Will] or be Frightened until the start of Gunvald's next Turn.

acts.name: Second Wind
acts.text: Bonus Action. Gunvald regains 15 HP.

acts.name: Indomitable
acts.text: Gunvald can reroll a failed Save. He must use the new roll.

creatures.name: Snow Golem
creatures.flav: A rough-hewn watchman of packed snow and ice, animated to guard a place or a person until it melts or is ordered otherwise.

acts.name: Slam
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Snowball
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Cold Absorption
acts.text: Whenever the golem is dealt Cold damage, it instead regains that much HP.

creatures.name: Coldlight Walker
creatures.flav: A radiant, frozen corpse that glows with a false dawn - beautiful right up until it turns to look at you.

acts.name: Slam
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Cold Ray
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Blinding Light
acts.text: Bonus Action. Sheds bright light to Near and dim light beyond that. A Being in its bright light must pass [Endure] or be Blinded until the start of the walker's next Turn.

acts.name: Icy Doom
acts.text: A Being it kills freezes solid for 9 Days, during which it can't be thawed, harmed by Fire, animated, or raised from the dead.

creatures.name: Avarice
creatures.flav: A tiefling wizard of the Arcane Brotherhood, chasing power in the ruins beneath the glacier and willing to freeze anyone who gets in her way.

acts.name: Cone of Cold
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Banishing Rebuke
acts.text: Reaction. When damaged by a Being she senses, banish it for 1 Minute to a frigid prison: it is Incapacitated and takes 3 (d10) Cold damage at the start of each of its Turns, repeating a Will Save at the end of each of its Turns to escape early.

creatures.name: Dzaan's Simulacrum
creatures.flav: A frost-pale duplicate of the missing wizard Dzaan, animated by the same magic he used to survive his own death - badly.

acts.name: Shocking Grasp
acts.text: Target can't take Reactions until the start of its next Turn.

acts.name: Magic Missile
acts.text: Always hits.

creatures.name: Duergar Mind Master
creatures.flav: A duergar psion whose dagger hurts less than the thoughts it leaves behind.

acts.name: Mind-Poison Dagger
acts.text: Psychic damage.

acts.name: Mind Mastery
acts.text: Target within Far must pass [Will] or the duergar forces it to Attack another Being it can see, or Move up to 10' in a direction of the duergar's choice, on its Reaction.

acts.name: Vanish
acts.text: The duergar is Invisible for up to 1 Hour, until it Attacks, Casts, or its Focus breaks.

creatures.name: Icewind Kobold
creatures.flav: A shivering little opportunist that has learned to dig deep and strike from the dark - alone, it's nothing; in a pack, it's a problem.

acts.name: Pack Tactics
acts.text: It has Favor on Attacks against a Target that has one of its Allies within Close.

creatures.name: Kobold Vampire Spawn
creatures.flav: A kobold that crossed the wrong cave in Termalaine's mines and came back changed, hungry, and considerably harder to kill.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: Target's Max HP is reduced by the damage dealt until it finishes a Shift; the vampire spawn heals for the same amount.

acts.name: Pack Tactics
acts.text: It has Favor on Attacks against a Target that has one of its Allies within Close.

acts.name: Lesser Regenerate II
acts.text: Regains 10 HP on each of its Turns unless it took damage it was Weak to in the last Round. It can't be reduced below 1 HP except by damage it is Weak to.

creatures.name: Frost Giant Skeleton
creatures.flav: A frost giant's bones, picked clean by wind and time, still swinging a greataxe for a master it can no longer name.

acts.name: Freezing Stare
acts.text: Target within Far it senses must pass [Endure] or take 17 (5d6) Cold damage and be Paralyzed until the end of its next Turn.

creatures.name: Chwinga
creatures.flav: A tiny nature spirit of Icewind Dale's dwindling wild places, shy, generous, and quick to hide in the nearest stone or stream.

acts.name: Magical Gift
acts.text: Targets a willing Humanlike within Close, who gains a minor supernatural charm (GM's discretion).

acts.name: Natural Shelter
acts.text: It can retreat into a rock, living plant, or natural fresh water in its space (no Action), where it can't be Targeted by anything. It can emerge with an Action.

acts.name: Evasion
acts.text: Checks or Saves it would take half damage on a pass instead take none, and it takes half on a fail.

creatures.name: Jarund Elkhardt
creatures.flav: King of the Tribe of the Elk, who fights with a warhammer in one hand and his shield as a second weapon in the other.

acts.name: Shield Bash
acts.text: Target of Large or smaller is shoved 5' and Jarund can Move into the space.

acts.name: Brute
acts.text: Jarund's weapon Attacks deal an extra damage die (already included above).

creatures.name: Bjornhild Solvigsdottir
creatures.flav: Queen of the Tribe of the Tiger, who wears Auril's favor like a second edge on her greataxe.

acts.name: Auril's Blessing
acts.text: A weapon Attack that hits deals an extra 11 (2d10) Cold damage.

creatures.name: Isarr Kronenstrom
creatures.flav: Leader of the Tribe of the Wolf in name only - the tribe follows him because they're too afraid to stop.

acts.name: Sickle
acts.text: Deals an extra 13 (2d12) damage if the Target has no Allies within Close.

acts.name: Blood Frenzy
acts.text: It has Favor on melee Attacks against a Target that isn't at full HP.

acts.name: Indomitable
acts.text: Isarr can reroll a failed Save. He must use the new roll.

creatures.name: Demos Magen
creatures.flav: A soldier-shaped construct from the ruins beneath the glacier, built to fight and little else.

acts.name: Fiery End
acts.text: When it dies, its body disintegrates in a harmless burst of fire and smoke, leaving behind anything it carried.

creatures.name: Galvan Magen
creatures.flav: A hovering construct that crackles faintly with stored lightning, built by the Netherese to guard what they couldn't carry.

acts.name: Shocking Touch
acts.text: Shock damage.

acts.name: Static Discharge
acts.text: Shock damage.

acts.name: Fiery End
acts.text: When it dies, its body disintegrates in a harmless burst of fire and smoke, leaving behind anything it carried.

creatures.name: Hypnos Magen
creatures.flav: A construct with silver-glowing eyes, built to talk enemies into laying down their arms - or into far worse ideas.

acts.name: Suggestion
acts.text: Charms the Target into following a reasonable suggestion for the duration. Only works on a Being it can speak to telepathically.

acts.name: Fiery End
acts.text: When it dies, its body disintegrates in a harmless burst of fire and smoke, leaving behind anything it carried.

creatures.name: Verbeeg Longstrider
creatures.flav: A lean, watchful verbeeg who ranges far ahead of its kin, spear in hand and half a dozen quiet spells up its sleeve.

acts.name: Sling
acts.text: Target is Dazed until the end of its next Turn if it fails.

acts.name: Simple Weapon Wielder
acts.text: Its weapon Attacks deal an extra damage die (already included above).

creatures.name: Verbeeg Marauder
creatures.flav: A verbeeg raider who has traded patience for plunder, and isn't shy about which one it enjoys more.

acts.name: Simple Weapon Wielder
acts.text: Its weapon Attacks deal an extra damage die (already included above).

creatures.name: Gnoll Vampire
creatures.flav: A gnoll raider who fed on the wrong corpse in the wrong crypt and rose again craving more.

acts.name: Bite
acts.text: Target's Max HP is reduced by the damage dealt until it finishes a Shift; the vampire heals for the same amount.

acts.name: Frightful Cackle
acts.text: Beings of its choice within Far that can hear it must pass [Will] or be Frightened (Cd6).

acts.name: Lesser Regenerate II
acts.text: Regains 10 HP on each of its Turns unless it took damage it was Weak to in the last Round. It can't be reduced below 1 HP except by damage it is Weak to.

creatures.name: Goliath Warrior
creatures.flav: A goliath fighter of the Spine of the World, at home on any cliff face and unbothered by the cold.

acts.name: Stone's Endurance
acts.text: Reaction. When damaged, reduce the damage taken by 9 (d12+3).

creatures.name: Yeti Tyke
creatures.flav: A yeti cub, more curious than dangerous - unless its parents are close, in which case it's not the problem.

acts.name: Claw
acts.text: Cold damage.

creatures.name: Nass Lantomir's Ghost
creatures.flav: A Netherese wizard's spirit, still furious about the theft that killed him and still cleverer than most things that will ever threaten you.

acts.name: Horrifying Visage
acts.text: Beings within Far that can see it must pass [Will] or be Frightened (1 Minute); if failed by 5 or more, also aged 1d4x10 years.

acts.name: Possession
acts.text: A Humanlike within Close must pass [Will] or be possessed: it is Incapacitated and the ghost controls its body (using the target's Stats) until the body drops to 0 HP, the ghost ends the possession (no Action), or the ghost is forced out by a Spell like Dispel.

creatures.name: Hengar Aesnvaard
creatures.flav: A militia captain of Bryn Shander, steady in a shield wall and stubborn everywhere else.

acts.name: Shield Bash
acts.text: Target of Medium or smaller must pass [Might] or be knocked Prone.

acts.name: Parry
acts.text: Reaction. Hengar gains +3 Armor against one melee Attack that would hit him, if he can see the Attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.

creatures.name: Mind Flayer
creatures.flav: An alien intellect wrapped in a squid-headed humanoid shape, patient, cruel, and always hungry for something a body can't hold.

acts.name: Tentacles
acts.text: Psychic damage. Target of Medium or smaller is Restrained until it escapes.

acts.name: Mind Blast
acts.text: Psychic damage. Targets are Dazed (1 Minute) if failed.

acts.name: Extract Brain
acts.text: Melee Attack against an Incapacitated Target it has Restrained: 30 (10d6) damage, killing instantly by devouring the brain if this reduces it to 0 HP.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Umber Hulk
creatures.flav: A burrowing horror of chitin and claw, its mandibles alone worse than most things Underdark tunnels produce.

acts.name: Confusing Gaze
acts.text: A Being that starts its Turn within Near and can see its eyes must pass [Will] or be Confused until the start of its next Turn. A Being can avert its eyes to avoid the Save, but then can't see it until its own next Turn.

creatures.name: Myconid Sovereign
creatures.flav: The eldest fungus of its circle, crowned in spore-dust, ruling a patch of glowing mushrooms deep under the Reghed Glacier.

acts.name: Fist
acts.text: Poison damage.

acts.name: Pacifying Spores
acts.text: A Being within Close must pass [Endure] or be Incapacitated (1 Minute), repeating the Save at the end of each of its Turns.

acts.name: Hallucination Spores
acts.text: A Being within Close must pass [Endure] or be Confused (1 Minute), repeating the Save at the end of each of its Turns.

acts.name: Sun Sickness
acts.text: While in sunlight, its Checks and Saves have Hinder, and it dies after 1 Hour in direct sunlight.

creatures.name: Quaggoth
creatures.flav: A shaggy, feral humanoid of the Underdark, more animal instinct than mind, and most dangerous when it's already hurt.

acts.name: Wounded Fury
acts.text: While it has 10 HP or fewer, it has Favor on Attacks and deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage with melee Attacks.

creatures.name: Barbed Devil
creatures.flav: A devil bristling with iron-hard spines, sent up from the Nine Hells whenever Xardorok's ambitions need a longer reach.

acts.name: Barbed Hide
acts.text: At the start of its Turn, any Being Grappling it takes 3 (d10) damage.

acts.name: Magic Ward II
acts.text: The first time it is unwillingly affected by a Spell each Round, the Caster must spend an extra 2 Mana to affect it.

creatures.name: Shield Guardian
creatures.flav: A hulking construct bound to a wearer's amulet, absorbing half of what would otherwise kill them - and hitting back twice as hard.

acts.name: Regeneration
acts.text: Regains 10 HP on each of its Turns if it has at least 1 HP.

acts.name: Bound
acts.text: While within Close of its amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian instead.

creatures.name: Spectator
creatures.flav: A small, floating eye-beast summoned to guard a place and never told when to stop.

acts.name: Eye Rays
acts.text: Choose per ray: Confused, Paralyzed, Frightened, or 14 (4d6) damage, each (1 Minute) if failed.

acts.name: Spell Reflection
acts.text: Reaction. If it passes a Save against a Spell, or a Spell Attack misses it, it can redirect the Spell to another Being it senses within Near instead.

creatures.name: Slaad Tadpole
creatures.flav: A wriggling seed of chaos, implanted in some unlucky Being and counting down to a very bad day.

creatures.name: Gnoll
creatures.flav: A hyena-headed raider driven by a demon's hunger, following whoever promises the next meal.

acts.name: Rampage
acts.text: When it reduces a Being to 0 HP with a melee Attack on its Turn, it can Move up to half its Speed and make a Bite Attack, as a Reaction.

creatures.name: Ice Mephit
creatures.flav: A cackling shard of animated ice, more nuisance than threat until it pops.

acts.name: Claws
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Frost Breath
acts.text: Cold damage.

acts.name: Death Burst
acts.text: When it dies, Beings within Close must pass [Reflex] or take 4 (d8) damage, half on a pass.

creatures.name: Merrow
creatures.flav: An ogre-kin of the deep water, harpoon in hand and a taste for anything that swims too close.

acts.name: Harpoon
acts.text: Target of Huge or smaller is pulled 20' toward it if it fails an [Might] Save.

creatures.name: Duergar
creatures.flav: A grim, gray-skinned dwarf of Xardorok's rank and file, unhappy to be here and twice as unhappy to see you.

acts.name: Enlarge
acts.text: For the duration, it is Large, and its War Pick dice explode.

acts.name: Vanish
acts.text: It is Invisible for up to 1 Hour, until it Attacks, Casts, or its Focus breaks.

creatures.name: Reghed Warrior
creatures.flav: A tundra tribesfolk armed with a spear and a lifetime of practice not freezing to death.

acts.name: Pack Tactics
acts.text: It has Favor on Attacks against a Target that has one of its Allies within Close.

creatures.name: Reghed Shaman
creatures.flav: A tribal healer and weather-reader who calls on old spirits when spears aren't enough.

acts.name: Entangle
acts.text: Targets are Restrained for the duration.

acts.name: Barkskin
acts.text: Grants itself or an Ally it touches +2 Armor for the duration.

creatures.name: Reghed Chieftain
creatures.flav: A tribal leader who earned the spear-right the old way, and defends it the same.

acts.name: Shield Bash
acts.text: Target of Medium or smaller must pass [Might] or be knocked Prone.

acts.name: Parry
acts.text: Reaction. Gains +3 Armor against one melee Attack that would hit it, if it can see the Attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.

creatures.name: Reghed Great Warrior
creatures.flav: A tribe's finest fighter, kept close to its leader's side for exactly the reasons you'd expect.

acts.name: Shield Bash
acts.text: Target of Medium or smaller must pass [Might] or be knocked Prone.

acts.name: Parry
acts.text: Reaction. Gains +3 Armor against one melee Attack that would hit it, if it can see the Attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.

creatures.name: Aarakocra
creatures.flav: A bird-folk scout of the high peaks, javelin in talon, most dangerous in a dive.

acts.name: Dive Attack
acts.text: If it Flies at least 30' straight toward a Target before hitting it with a melee Attack, that Attack deals an extra damage die.
